tools.name: get_business_card
tools.description: Returns the public EAC Partners business card: name, emails, phone, address, time zone, and website.

tools.name: list_offerings
tools.description: Lists EAC Partners offerings, including a footnote of small demonstrations built by EAC Partners. The ERP title comes from configuration.

tools.name: match_need
tools.description: Matches a short need to offerings in the published catalog only. Does not invent services.

tools.name: get_privacy_notice
tools.description: Returns the Concierge privacy notice. Host AI vendors may see tool calls and tool results.

tools.name: list_insights
tools.description: Lists Insights articles with title, summary, date, and canonical URL. Full article text is not included.

tools.name: search_insights
tools.description: Searches Insights titles and summaries. Returns a summary and canonical URL.

tools.name: get_insight
tools.description: Returns one Insights article by vertical and slug, or by canonical URL. Summary and URL only unless full text is enabled.

tools.name: submit_referral
tools.description: Queues a partner referral for staff review. Nothing is sent automatically.

tools.name: leave_lead_note
tools.description: Queues a short note from a prospective customer. Web addresses are rejected.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Reports the signed-in customer. Sign-in is not enabled, and this build returns no customer record.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: Lists customer invoices. Not available until phase 2, and this build returns no records.

tools.name: get_invoice
tools.description: Returns one invoice. Not available until phase 2, and this build returns no record.

tools.name: download_invoice_pdf
tools.description: Returns an invoice PDF. Not available until phase 2, and this build returns no file.

tools.name: list_subscriptions
tools.description: Lists subscriptions. Not available until phase 2, and this build returns no records.

tools.name: list_billed_time
tools.description: Lists billed time. Not available until phase 2, and this build returns no records.

tools.name: open_support_request
tools.description: Opens a support request. Not available until phase 2, and this build does not store one.

tools.name: list_open_slots
tools.description: Lists open appointment slots in America/New_York for discovery, project review, or support. Phase 1 uses a deterministic schedule stub.

tools.name: request_appointment
tools.description: Queues an appointment request for a slotId previously returned by list_open_slots. Status is pending confirmation. Nothing is sent or held automatically.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_business_card, list_insights, search_insights, get_insight, list_open_slots · Private data: whoami, list_invoices, get_invoice, download_invoice_pdf, list_subscriptions, list_billed_time · Public sink: submit_referral.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_business_card, list_insights, search_insights, get_insight, list_open_slots · Private data: whoami, list_invoices, get_invoice, download_invoice_pdf, list_subscriptions, list_billed_time · Public sink: submit_referral

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
